description: Rosie 1400, 25 / 305 / 25 mm pick-and-place cycle with 1 kg: joint positions, velocities and accelerations every 1 ms, plus the TCP in base_link. Starts and ends at rest at A_low.
note: Acceleration is piecewise constant; at a switch instant the sample carries the following phase's value. The last row is the exact end time.
